answer: Rule: every identity pays quadratically for repeated actions in one epoch. Action 1 costs 1 unit of locked stake, action 10 costs 100, and the stake is burned on use. One honest juniper agent doing 10 actions pays 385 units; an attacker running 100 fakes pays 38,500 for the same work. Cheap first actions are the haven for honest agents, and the rising bill is the glacier that freezes out anyone scaling fakes.
